posts.title: Just some small talk
posts.description: Dear friend, I apologize. I thought I would be sending you letters more frequently, but alas, time has gotten away from me. This is always how my "internet life" ends up. posts.description: Dear friend, I recently watched You’ve Got Mail… again.
